cards.title: Hour 14 error spike
cards.detail: Hour 14 logged 1460 errors out of 9225 requests (15.8% error rate), versus about 31 errors per 8899 requests (0.35%) in every other hour of the week.

cards.title: Hour 3 traffic gap
cards.detail: Hour 3 recorded only 2 requests, both of which errored, compared to roughly 8899 requests seen in every other hour - consistent with an outage or a data collection gap.

cards.title: model-epsilon fully broken
cards.detail: model-epsilon shows 40 requests and 40 errors, a 100% failure rate, with $0 spend recorded, indicating a non-functional integration that isn't even generating billable traffic.

cards.title: caller-07 has an outsized per-request cost
cards.detail: caller-07 spent $174.12 across 1180 requests ($0.148/request), roughly 9-10x the rate of caller-01 ($1643.86 over 105832 requests, $0.016/request) and most other callers.

cards.title: caller-01 concentrates traffic and spend
cards.detail: caller-01 alone accounts for 105832 of 204993 requests (51.6% of total) and $1643.86 of $3354.82 spend (49% of total).

cards.title: Cache hit rates split into two clear groups
cards.detail: 12 of 24 callers show cache hit rates below 0.09 (e.g., caller-07 0.04, caller-21 0.037, caller-11 0.055), while the remaining callers sit between 0.82 and 0.89, pointing to inconsistent cache configuration across callers.
